description.value: cowdog is a small independent coffee shop in Vancouver with at least two locations, including this Oak Street branch. The brand has a distinct personality — operating under the parent name 'Be Less Shitty Club' — and sells specialty coffee alongside seasonal baked goods like made-to-order pumpkin pies available for pre-order pickup. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a neighbourhood café-style experience rather than a large commercial chain.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as the 'oak' branch of cowdog at 3720 Oak Street, but every page of the website footer consistently lists the address as '1927 W 4th Ave, Vancouver BC', indicating the website represents a different (likely primary) location; the OSM address is unconfirmed by the website. The Shopify store is active with a 2026 copyright, confirming the business is operational, but no cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. OSM tags outdoor_seating=no and the website provides no detail on bike parking, water, washrooms, or WiFi.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists 3720 Oak Street (V6H 2M4) but the website footer consistently shows '1927 W 4th Ave, Vancouver BC' on every page. OSM tags branch=oak suggesting multiple locations exist; the website may only display the primary/W4th location's address. The Oak Street address should be field-verified.

OSM opening hours (Th-Su 09:00-16:00) conflict with website footer ('Open Daily 9am-5pm'), likely because the website reflects the primary W4th location. Hours for the Oak Street branch are unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active coffee shop with a live Shopify website and 2026 copyright; the OSM 'oak' branch tag supports this being a legitimate second location even though the website address does not confirm the OSM address.
enrichment_extras.notes: The parent company legal name appears to be 'Be Less Shitty Club' per the Terms of Service page. The online store currently lists only sold-out seasonal pre-order items (pumpkin pie), so the product range in-store may be broader than what the website reflects.

wow_evidence: small independent coffee shop... operating under the parent name 'Be Less Shitty Club'
